import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem connected_iUnion_of_generated_overlap {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι]
    {A : ι → Set X} {R : ι → ι → Prop}
    (hA : ∀ i, IsConnected (A i))
    (hR : ∀ i j, R i j → (A i ∩ A j).Nonempty)
    (hChain : ∀ i j, Relation.ReflTransGen R i j) :
    IsConnected (⋃ i, A i) := by
  have hOverlap :
      ∀ i j, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j => (A i ∩ A j).Nonempty) i j := by
    intro i j
    induction hChain i j with
    | refl =>
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | tail hxy hyz ih =>
        exact ih.tail (hR _ _ hyz)
  exact IsConnected.iUnion_of_reflTransGen hA hOverlap

    (hA : ∀ i, IsConnected (A i))
    (hR : ∀ i j, R i j → (A i ∩ A j).Nonempty)
    (hChain : ∀ i j, Relation.ReflTransGen R i j) :
    IsConnected (⋃ i, A i) := by
  let S : ι → ι → Prop := fun i j => (A i ∩ A j).Nonempty
  
  have hPath :
      ∀ i j, Relation.ReflTransGen R i j →
        Relation.ReflTransGen S i j := by
    intro i j hij
    induction hij with
    | refl =>
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | tail hpath hedge ih =>
        exact ih.tail (hR _ _ hedge)
  
  have hSChain : ∀ i j, Relation.ReflTransGen S i j := by
    intro i j
    exact hPath i j (hChain i j)
  
  exact IsConnected.iUnion_of_reflTransGen
    (s := A) (H := hA) (K := hSChain)
